key_principles: Clarity is king: Data must be instantly readable
Function over form: Decoration serves data, not vice versa
Architectural precision: Use grids and lines to structure content
Trustworthy palette: Use established financial colors but refine them

buttons.style: rounded-md font-medium transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2

variants.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 focus:ring-slate-500 shadow-sm
variants.danger: bg-white text-rose-600 border border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:border-rose-300 focus:ring-rose-500

cards.style: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
cards.header: px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between

inputs.style: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 transition-all duration-200

tables.wrapper: relative w-full overflow-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-200
tables.header_cell: h-12 px-4 text-left align-middle font-medium text-slate-500 [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0

badges.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:ring-offset-2

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on background (optional) or clean white paper look

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text-slate-500 is only used for secondary info on white backgrounds
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'search-input', 'submit-btn')

image_urls.hero_abstract: None (Use CSS patterns or Lucide Icons)

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/JS with Tailwind classes for layout. Do not over-engineer with complex libraries.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do not introduce new colors without reason.
Ensure the dashboard is responsive. Use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12' pattern.
For the Multibagger score, use a color-coded badge or progress bar (Green > 70, Yellow 40-70, Red < 40).
For F&O Signals, use clear 'BUY' (Green) and 'SELL' (Red) indicators.
All stock prices and financial numbers MUST use the 'font-mono' class (JetBrains Mono).
Use 'lucide-react' for icons (e.g., TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Activity, DollarSign).
Implement the 'Tabs' component using state to switch between 'Multibagger' and 'F&O' views.
Maintain a clean, professional 'Architectural' aesthetic - lots of white space, thin borders, precise alignment.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive element (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows) for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only for overlays/modals in light mode (frosted glass).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use 'sonner' for toasts
Sonner component are located in '/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx'
